flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4173 then You are KANE, challenging the AI Dungeon Master ABLE.
Solve the escape room entirely through the visible browser UI.
Explore useful interactive objects, collect items, unlock dependent objects, and use the visible color sequence plus discovered clues to determine the four-digit exit code.
Get the four-digit exit code from the visible color sequence plus discovered clues and save as {{discovered_code}}.
Then enter {{discovered_code}} and verify that the page displays "YOU ESCAPED".
Do not inspect source files or developer tools and do not assume the solution.
If a gameplay dependency makes the room logically impossible, fail the objective and explain the blocking dependency.

verdict.root_cause: The agent assumed the room was still impossible from the summary screen, instead of entering the duel and checking the repaired room through the visible UI.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent's own actions caused this outcome. It stopped after analyzing the landing/dashboard view and did not take the obvious available next step to continue the scenario. The UI showed an actionable "BEGIN DUEL" control and status text indicating Kane should re-verify the room, but the agent instead treated prior blocked-attempt evidence as a current blocker and became stuck. There is no evidence that the product prevented interaction, hid required controls, or threw an in-flow gameplay error.
